title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – CRR and SLR Exemption Window) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
description: RBI amended FCNR(B) and NRE deposit interest rate directions to shorten the CRR and SLR exemption window from September 30, 2026 to August 31, 2026 for fresh FCNR(B) deposits with 3-5 year tenors and NRE deposits of 3 years and above across commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks, and co-operative banks.
